annotations.title: DOL Davis-Bacon wage decisions by county

description: List the U.S. Department of Labor's current Residential and Building general wage decisions for a county, with modification number, publish date and SAM.gov link. With state alone, lists the state's decisions and the counties each covers. Decisions are listed, never selected for a project: HUD labor standards staff make that selection.

county.description: County name, e.g. Harris. "County" or "Parish" is optional.

type.description: Limit to one schedule. Omit for both.
